optimized_decoder.hardware: one Blackhole P300C (1x1 mesh, device id 0)

persistent_allocation_accounting.scope: persistent decoder-layer weights, batch-aware packed expert weights, selected attention copies, selected reader-1 DRAM-sharded O/packed-dense/down weights, and the 256-byte trace-stable routing base; excludes caller-owned KV cache and transient activations
persistent_allocation_accounting.capacity_effect: none for the per-layer context contract; full-stack placement is intentionally outside the optimized-decoder stage

notes: Both layer kinds pass traced decode at the last valid advertised position and physical non-aligned prefill one token below the advertised context.
Optimization does not alter paged-cache ownership, block geometry, or page-table semantics; BF16 is the accepted cache policy.
The opt-in BFP8 cache candidate is deterministic but fails cache-consuming decode: minimum HF PCC is 0.994624887 sliding and 0.988673202 full versus the 0.995 threshold.
Persistent allocation is measured from device buffer page counts and page sizes with duplicate buffer IDs counted once.
The accounting includes the distinct batch-32 BFP8 packed expert gate/up allocation, the selected 256-byte routing base, and deduplicates attention aliases by device buffer ID.

Every retained decode DRAM-sharded weight has a measured selected consumer. The setup-only interleaved packed dense source is released after sharding; original separate dense weights remain for prefill and B32. The QKV watcher workaround is transient L1 storage and does not change persistent capacity.

multichip_decoder.hardware: one P300C QB2: 1/2/4 devices as accepted proxies for mandatory P150/P150x2/P150x4 profiles
multichip_decoder.terminal_embedding_lm_head_contract: mandatory downstream BFP8_B placement; physical tile accounting; not implemented by the decoder stage
multichip_decoder.operational_reserve_policy: configured 64 MiB trace region plus conservative source-live prefill tensors plus profile-specific allocator reserve

boundary_evidence.hardware_status: passed real-weight sliding/full representative-layer probes at 50623 and 50624; 50625 is rejected by the host capacity guard

P150x2.selected_policy_revalidation: passed final no-packed direct PCC, independent HF PCC, mixed-layer stacked decode, and warmed trace/performance gates; see multichip_decoder/artifacts/final_profiles_after_capacity.xml and warmed_required_profiles_final.xml

notes: The 262143-token TP4 prefill probes use real checkpoint weights and verify a finite last-token result for both layer kinds.
The last-position TP4 decode probes use replicated page tables/current positions, device-initialized KV history, sentinel readback, trace capture/replay, and deterministic repeat replay.
Logical S=33 prefill plus decode verifies non-tile-aligned tails, local cache ownership, and bit-exact output replicas.
The capacity-required BFP4 exception is limited to TP1 full-attention expert gate/up weights and passes representative prefill/decode PCC 0.995.
BF16 embedding plus a separate BF16 LM head require 2952790016 bytes on TP1 and do not fit after the decoder/KV placement plus final norm and the operating reserve.
Full-stack placement therefore requires downstream embedding and LM-head storage in BFP8_B; this decoder stage records but does not implement or claim terminal/logit correctness for that policy.

The operating reserve includes the configured 64 MiB trace region, all conservatively source-live prefill tensors, and the prior profile-specific allocator slack; chunked SDPA does not bound the full QKV or inherited residual lifetime.

Packed expert decode retains an additional physical BFP8 tensor per layer and is selected on TP4 only. Capacity disables TP2's 8088453120-byte retained copy; TP4 retains 4411883520 packed-expert bytes plus 642611200 bytes of prior O/dense copies.

TP1 packed expert decode is disabled by a hard capacity limit: even the unselected all-BFP4 physical-tile lower bound is 8564244480 bytes, larger than its 7075084288-byte decoder-stage headroom at the reduced context.

At 262144 tokens the conservative TP1 full-stack projection is 56398546944 bytes, so the shared 32 GiB device cannot honor the advertised prefill context with the correctness-proven precision policy. The per-profile hard limit is 50624; 50623 is the tighter nonaligned boundary and 50625 is rejected before device allocation.
TP2 and TP4 preserve the advertised 262144-token contract with conservative headroom of 788749312 and 939828224 bytes per device.
P150 real-weight representative-layer probes pass at both the 50623-token nonaligned boundary and aligned 50624-token limit; 50625 is rejected safely before device allocation.

The earlier P150 53343/53344 real-weight probes also passed but are superseded/non-boundary evidence after correcting MoE concat lifetime to include both accumulated chunks and the newly allocated concat output.

optimized_multichip_decoder.hardware: one P300C QB2: 1/2/4 devices as accepted proxies for mandatory P150/P150x2/P150x4 profiles
optimized_multichip_decoder.activation_dtype: BF16 for attention, dense MLP, MoE, residual/norm, and CCL payloads; role-isolated and combined BFP8 candidates were rejected
optimized_multichip_decoder.activation_sharding: decode-local R22 height sharding where selected; unchanged public replicated BF16 TILE DRAM residual
optimized_multichip_decoder.expert_routing: gate-selected runtime top-8 with exact indexed sparse execution; no dense all-expert execution and no fixed nnz metadata
optimized_multichip_decoder.inter_layer_residual_contract: replicated BF16 TILE DRAM [1,1,logical_M,2816]; no gather, reshard, or collective between decoder layers
notes: The optimized packed expert tensor replaces, rather than supplements, the separate gate/up tensors and is shared by prefill and decode.
P150x2 full attention adds a 61276160-byte retained O-projection family and remains within the conservative full-stack capacity projection.
P150x4 reclaims the prior 4411883520-byte redundant packed-expert retained copy and retains a 288358400-byte DRAM-sharded QKV decode copy across the 25 sliding-attention layers.
No public sequence alignment is added. The decoder continues to own tile padding, cache masking, and logical slicing, with final S=33 prefill/decode trace evidence.
Indexed sparse routing adds only transient exact TopK indices and compact scores; it does not change persistent per-device memory or the context limit.

Full-attention dense gate, up, and down are BF16 for recorded-activation correctness. Coherent R22 TP1/TP2 no longer allocate an unused packed dense tensor, offsetting most of that precision repair's persistent cost.
The final-source P150 50624 physical boundary was rerun after changing packed-expert construction to avoid all separate gate/up device allocations; both meaningful layer kinds pass.
